28451.description:
Woodlark Mining is seeking an experienced and motivated 
GIS Geologist
 to join our Geology and Exploration team on Woodlark Island.


The GIS Geologist will provide GIS, spatial data management, geological mapping, and technical support to exploration and resource development activities. The role will work closely with Geologists, Survey, Mine Technical Services, Environmental, and other site teams.


Key Responsibilities




Manage and maintain geological GIS databases and spatial datasets.


Produce geological, structural, geochemical, drilling, exploration, topographic, and tenement maps.


Integrate geological, geochemical, geophysical, drilling, survey, and field data.


Provide GIS support for exploration planning, geological mapping, sampling, and drilling programmes.


Undertake spatial analysis to support geological interpretation and exploration targeting.


Prepare maps, figures, plans, and GIS outputs for technical reports and management presentations.


Maintain high standards of data accuracy, QA/QC, metadata, and database integrity.


Support geological modelling, resource development, mine planning, and environmental mapping as required.


Assist with field data collection and GIS requirements during exploration programmes.


Ensure all activities are undertaken in accordance with Woodlark Mining's 
HSE policies, procedures, and standards
.




About You


The successful applicant will have:




A tertiary qualification in 
Geology, GIS, Geoscience, Geospatial Science
, or a related discipline.


Previous experience in a GIS Geologist, Geological GIS, or similar role within mining or mineral exploration.


Strong working knowledge of 
ArcGIS, MapInfo and/or QGIS
.


Experience managing geological and spatial databases.


Good understanding of geological mapping, exploration, drilling, sampling, and geoscientific data.


Strong analytical, organisational, and communication skills.


High attention to detail and commitment to data integrity.


Ability to work effectively in a remote mining and exploration environment.


A strong commitment to 
safety, environmental responsibility, and teamwork
.




Desirable


Experience with 
Micromine, SQL, Python/ArcPy, remote sensing, UAV/drone data, GNSS/GPS, geochemical/geophysical datasets
, or other geological modelling and database systems will be highly regarded.


What We Offer




Opportunity to work on a significant mining project in Papua New Guinea.


Exposure to exploration, resource development, and multidisciplinary technical activities.


Professional development and career growth opportunities.


Competitive remuneration and site-based employment conditions.




Applications:
 Interested applicants should submit a current CV and brief cover letter outlining their qualifications and relevant experience no later than 22 September 2026 to;

28440.description:
CreditBank PNG is recruiting a suitable candidate for the role of 
Product Manager – Merchant Services.


 


The Product Manager – Merchant Services is responsible for the end-to-end management, growth, performance and governance of the CreditBank PNG (CBP) ’s merchant acquiring portfolio. This includes Merchant Services, EFTPOS and other payment acceptance solutions.


 


The role is accountable for developing and managing merchant product propositions, pricing, product performance, go-to-market plans, customer experience, product governance, risk controls and ongoing product improvements.


 


The Product Manager will work closely with Sales, Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Marketing, Legal to ensure merchant products are commercially viable, operationally reliable, compliant and aligned with CBP’s digital and payments strategy.


 


This role supports revenue growth by expanding CBP’s merchant acquiring footprint, improving merchant activation and usage, increasing transaction volumes and delivering payment solutions that meet the needs of business, SME and commercial customers.


 


Accountabilities & Responsibilities


Strategic:




Develop and maintain the Merchant Services product strategy and roadmap.


Define the value proposition for EFTPOS and other merchant acceptance solutions.


Identify target merchant segments, including SMEs, corporates, retailers, schools, churches, professional services, market operators and mobile businesses.


Assess market trends, competitor activity, customer needs and emerging payment technologies.


Develop business cases for new merchant products, enhancements and investment proposals.


Lead or support New Product Approval submissions for new acquiring products and channels.


Ensure new products are not launched without the required product governance, risk, compliance and approval signoffs.


Recommend pricing, fee structures and commercial models for merchant products.


Monitor the profitability and commercial performance of the merchant acquiring portfolio.


Support the Bank’s digital-first strategy by expanding electronic payment acceptance.


Work with Sales and Business Development to identify portfolio growth opportunities.


Support strategic partnerships that expand merchant acceptance and digital payment capability.


Provide product input into annual planning, budgeting and forecasting.


Track delivery of approved product initiatives and benefits realisation.


Provide management reporting on product performance, risks, issues and opportunities.




 


Customer Experience




Design and continuously improve the merchant customer journey from enquiry to onboarding, activation, usage, servicing and retention.


Define merchant eligibility criteria and onboarding requirements.


Ensure the merchant application process is clear, efficient and supported by appropriate forms and guidance.


Develop merchant-facing product information, including product sheets, FAQs, user guides and service information.


Ensure merchants understand fees, settlement timelines, transaction processes, chargebacks and support channels.


Monitor merchant complaints, feedback and service issues.


Identify root causes of customer pain points and recommend improvements.


Work with Contact Centre, Branches, Sales and Operations to ensure consistent responses to merchant enquiries.


Support merchant education on card acceptance, digital payments, fraud prevention, refunds, reversals and settlement.


Monitor inactive or low-usage merchants and coordinate actions to improve activation and usage.


Ensure product communications are clear, accurate, compliant and customer friendly.


Support marketing campaigns that promote merchant services and digital payment acceptance.


Ensure frontline teams are trained and ready before product launches or campaigns.


Monitor merchant satisfaction and recommend improvements to product features and service delivery.




 


Operational




Define business requirements for merchant products, including EFTPOS, Mobile POS and future acquiring channels.


Work with Technology and vendors to support product configuration, testing, release management and defect resolution.


Coordinate product testing, user acceptance testing and production readiness activities.


Support terminal deployment requirements, including device allocation, activation, replacement, retrieval and retirement processes.


Monitor terminal utilisation, uptime, transaction success rates and device performance.


Work with Operations to ensure settlement, reconciliation, refunds, reversals and exception handling processes are effective.


Monitor settlement exceptions, failed transactions and reconciliation breaks.


Ensure merchant service fees, rentals and transaction charges are correctly applied.


Maintain product documentation, including procedures, pricing schedules, terms, user guides and process maps.


Coordinate operational readiness before launch, including procedures, training, support models and escalation paths.


Monitor vendor and processor performance against agreed service levels.


Track product incidents, defects, service issues and resolution actions.


Work with Risk, Compliance and Fraud teams to monitor fraud, chargebacks, disputes and merchant risk indicators.


Ensure product controls are in place for high-risk merchants, transaction limits, device security and merchant monitoring.


Support audit, risk and compliance reviews and ensure product-related actions are closed on time.


Maintain product governance records and ensure product changes follow approved change processes.




 


Key Competencies:




Customer- and outcome-focused


Analytical and commercially minded


Collaborative and influential


Strong ownership and accountability


Critical thinking and interpersonal skills.


Written and verbal communication skills.


Documentation and reporting skills.


Pro-active with a sense of urgency


Excellent working knowledge of tools such as Microsoft applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint.




 


Required Experience:




Minimum of 5 years’ experience in banking, payments, product management, merchant services, cards, digital banking or financial services.


Experience in merchant acquiring, EFTPOS, card products or digital payment solutions would be highly desirable.


Experience managing product performance, revenue, pricing, customer growth and profitability.


Experience working with Sales, Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Marketing teams.


Experience preparing product papers, business cases, product requirements or go-to-market plans.


Experience supporting product launches, system changes, testing and operational readiness.


Experience in data analysis, reporting, dashboards and product performance tracking.


Experience in a regulated banking or financial services environment.




 


Formal Qualifications:


The preferred qualifications include:




Bachelor’s degree in business, Commerce, Banking, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Information Systems or a related field.


Postgraduate qualification in Business, Finance, Strategy, Digital Banking or Product Management would be an advantage.

28435.description:
POSITION SUMMARY


The Reservations Agent is responsible for processing reservation enquiries, bookings, amendments, and cancellations through various communication channels, including telephone and email. The role involves identifying guest needs, confirming room availability and rates, promoting hotel products and services, maintaining accurate reservation records, and supporting revenue generation through effective sales and upselling techniques. The successful candidate will provide professional customer service while maintaining confidentiality, accuracy, and compliance with hotel policies and procedures.


 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES




Accurately process reservation requests, amendments, cancellations, and enquiries received via telephone, email, and other reservation channels.


Verify room availability, rates, packages, and special offers, ensuring all reservations are entered correctly into the reservation system.


Provide guests with information regarding accommodation, hotel facilities, services, promotions, and special packages.


Prepare and issue booking confirmations, payment documentation, and reservation correspondence in a timely and professional manner.


Identify guest needs and recommend suitable room types, packages, and additional services to maximize guest satisfaction and revenue opportunities.


Apply upselling and suggestive selling techniques to promote hotel products, services, transfers, tours, and other value-added offerings.


Manage waitlists, special requests, group bookings, and special billing arrangements accurately and efficiently.


Process reservation modifications, including extensions, early departures, and special accommodation requests.


Monitor and assist with the management of no-show reservations and reservation discrepancies.


Maintain accurate reservation records and prepare reports as requested by management.

POSITION SUMMARY


The Accounts Payable Officer is responsible for receiving, reviewing, processing, and reconciling supplier invoices and payments while maintaining accurate financial records and supporting month-end reporting activities. The role requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, confidentiality, and adherence to internal controls and accounting standards. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with internal departments and external vendors to ensure timely and compliant financial operations.

Previous experience within the hospitality industry would be an advantage.


Sound understanding of accounts payable processes, reconciliations, and financial controls.


Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, and experience using financial or accounting systems.


Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.


Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial information with professionalism and integrity.


Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

28425.description:
SENIOR OPERATIONS MANAGER


 


The Wildlife Conservation Society (WCS) is an international non-governmental organisation committed to working with communities, government, and other partners to manage wildlife and wild places for biodiversity and human well-being.


 


WCS PNG seeks a dynamic 
Senior
 
Operations Manager
 with significant experience in managing overall operational management of programmes in Papua New Guinea with the ability to develop the capacity of local finance and operations staff. The position can either be based in Goroka, Eastern Highlands Province, or Port Moresby, National Capital District. The position reports to the Country Director and is full-time.


 


Main Responsibilities:




Technical Leadership and Operational Management






Lead all WCS Operations functions: procurement, asset management, including safe operations of WCS’s fleet of vehicles and boats, facilities maintenance and improvement, IT, travel and logistics, and field safety and security.


Develop and implement the annual Operations plan and budget in coordination with the Finance and Programme teams;


Ensure timely, quality operational support to all program sites in line with activity plans;


Drive process improvement, development and standardisation of standard operation procedures (SOPs), and adoption of best practise across Operations and field sites. Ensure that all safety and logistics equipment and assets are maintained and undergo regular service checks to minimise downtime and delays to programme activities.






Compliance, Risk and Financial Management






Ensure all Operations activities comply with WCS policies, donor regulations, and PNG law;


Oversee procurement planning, asset management, vendor relations, and ensuring that WCS PNG act with the highest integrity and adherence to WCS’s Code of Conduct;


Supervise the Finance Manager, ensure financial management requirements are met, and provide strategic support on overall financial and budget processes.


Identify and mitigate operational risk related to safety, security, and fraud.






Team Leadership and Capacity Building






Supervise, mentor and develop the WCS Operations team.


Conduct performance management and ensure clear workplans for all direct reports.


Build capacity of programme staff to ensure streamlined adoption of and compliance with all operations procedures.






Stakeholder Engagement and Representation






Represent Operations at SMT and Programme meetings;


Liaise with vendors, government authorities, and partners on operational matters


Act as the primary point of contact for all country-level operational matters




Key Competencies and Experience:


Essential:




Bachelor’s degree in business, logistics, general management, or related fields. Master of Business Administration or equivalent preferred.


Minimum of seven to ten years’ experience in Operations and Administration in the private sector or major company or organisation with at least three years in a senior or leading role.


Proven experience managing procurement, vehicle fleets, and facilities and compliance in PNG.


Basic understanding of complex international donor requirements related to operations and finance, such as the French Development Agency (AFD).


Extremely organised and able to mentor staff to improve organisation skills, develop strong workflows and processes.


Ability to anticipate and prevent issues that affect staff safety and programme activities


Willingness and motivation to take ownership for tasks




Desirable:




Experience working within large international organisations with multiple field/office sites or similar entities


At least five years of experience in the private sector, corporations or not profit organisation.


Willingness to travel to field sites.


Good communication skills, both written and verbal, as well as strong analytical skills. English required.


Effective “roll up the sleeves” work ethic, with attention to detail.


Proven managerial skill and ability to work in a team setting within an organisation.


Commitment to WCS’s values of respect, accountability and transparency, innovation, diversity and inclusion, collaboration, and integrity

28424.description:
POSITION SUMMARY


The Security Guard is responsible for safeguarding the hotel, its guests, associates, visitors, and assets through proactive patrols, monitoring security systems, responding to incidents, and supporting emergency response activities. The role requires maintaining high standards of safety, professionalism, confidentiality, and guest service while ensuring compliance with company policies, workplace health and safety requirements, and applicable Papua New Guinea employment and safety standards.


 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES




Conduct regular patrols of guest areas, public spaces, hotel grounds, perimeter boundaries, and back-of-house areas to ensure safety and security.


Monitor CCTV systems, fire life safety systems, alarms, access control systems, and other security equipment.


Control and monitor entry and exit points for guests, associates, contractors, and visitors.


Assist guests with access issues, directions, inquiries, and security-related concerns in a professional and courteous manner.


Respond promptly to emergencies, incidents, accidents, disturbances, thefts, safety hazards, and security breaches.


Assist with emergency response procedures, including fire evacuations, power outages, bomb threats, natural disasters, and other critical incidents.


Complete accurate incident reports, shift reports, investigation records, and daily security activity logs.


Conduct hazard inspections and identify, report, and follow up on safety risks, maintenance issues, and unsafe conditions.


Support workplace health and safety initiatives by promoting hazard identification, risk reporting, and incident prevention.


Assist with investigations, evidence gathering, witness interviews, and documentation of security-related incidents.


Perform bag checks, locker inspections, and asset protection activities in accordance with company policies and procedures.


Escort unauthorized persons from hotel premises professionally and safely when required.


Maintain confidentiality of all security, guest, associate, and company information.


Communicate effectively with hotel departments, emergency services, contractors, and management regarding safety and security matters.


Support the Emergency Response Team and carry out assigned responsibilities during emergencies.


Maintain professional grooming, appearance, conduct, and customer service standards at all times.


Perform physical duties including extended walking, standing, stair climbing, and responding quickly to workplace situations.




 


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS




Grade 10 or Grade 12 School Certificate or equivalent qualification.


Previous experience in security, law enforcement, emergency services, hospitality security, or related fields is advantageous but not essential.


Current First Aid and CPR certification would be an advantage.


Basic knowledge of CCTV systems, access control systems, and emergency response procedures.


Strong understanding of workplace health and safety principles and risk management practices.


Good written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare accurate reports.


Ability to remain calm and professional when managing emergencies, conflicts, and difficult situations.


Honest, trustworthy, and able to maintain strict confidentiality.


Strong observation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.


Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


Physically fit and capable of standing, walking, patrolling, and performing manual duties throughout extended shifts.


Flexible and willing to work rotating shifts, weekends, public holidays, and overnight duties as required

28232.description:
Recruitment Officer


People & Culture (P&C) - Port Moresby, NCD




 












Position Title: Recruitment Officer 
Department: People & Culture 
Location: IBSUniversity, 11 Mile Campus 
Reports To: Recruitment Manager 


Employment Type: Full-Time


Position Overview 


The Recruitment Officer is responsible for managing and executing the end-to-end recruitment 
process to attract, select, and onboard top talent for IBSUniversity. This role requires building strong 
relationships with hiring managers, developing innovative sourcing strategies, and ensuring a positive 
candidate experience to support the university's strategic goals. The officer also manages labor and 
immigration processes for expatriates and their dependents. 


Key Responsibilities 


1. Recruitment Planning and Strategy 




Collaborate with department heads to understand current and future workforce 
requirements. 


Develop job descriptions and specifications in consultation with hiring managers. 


Create and implement recruitment plans to attract a diverse pool of qualified 
candidates. 


Stay updated on market trends to adjust strategies for hard-to-fill or critical roles. 




2. Sourcing and Advertising 




Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to identify potential candidates 
through online job boards, social media platforms, recruitment agencies, and  employee referrals. 


Design and post engaging job advertisements to attract quality candidates. 


Build and maintain a talent pipeline for current and future hiring needs. 




3. Screening and Selection 




Review applications and shortlist candidates based on qualifications, experience, and 
role requirements. 


Conduct initial phone screenings to assess candidate suitability. 


Schedule, coordinate, and participate in interviews with hiring managers and panel 
members. 


Administer pre-employment assessments and conduct reference and background 
checks. 




4. Offer Management and Onboarding 




Prepare and negotiate employment offers in alignment with organizational policies. 


Coordinate the onboarding process for new hires, ensuring all documentation and 
orientation requirements are met. 


Liaise with payroll and other departments to ensure a seamless transition for new 
employees. 




5. Candidate Experience 




Ensure timely communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process. 


Provide constructive feedback to unsuccessful candidates when requested. 


Promote IBS University as an employer of choice by delivering a positive candidate 
experience. 




6. Reporting and Metric




Maintain accurate and up-to-date recruitment records. 


Generate reports on recruitment metrics, including time-to-hire, cost-per-hire, and  candidate satisfaction. 


Evaluate the effectiveness of recruitment efforts and recommend improvements. 




7. Compliance 




Ensure recruitment practices comply with employment laws and university policies. 


Maintain confidentiality of sensitive candidate and organizational information. 




8. Labor and Immigration Processes 




Manage expatriate recruitment, including coordination of work permits and visas for 
new hires, their dependents, and existing expatriate staff and their dependents. 


Handle renewals of work permits and visas for expatriate staff and dependents in a  timely manner. 


Fast-track work permits and visas through networks and other creative solutions to  minimize delays. 


Liaise with government authorities and agencies to ensure compliance with labor  and immigration regulations. 




Key Qualifications and Skills 


Education/Qualification




Bachelor’s degree/Diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 
Experience 


Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment, preferably in higher education or a similar 
industry. 


Familiarity with labor and immigration processes for expatriates and their dependents is an 
advantage. 




Skills and Competencies 




Strong understanding of recruitment and selection processes. 


Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 


Proficiency in sourcing candidates through various channels. 


Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple 
priorities. 


Attention to detail and problem-solving ability. 


Ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 




Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 




Time-to-hire for each position. 


Cost-per-hire relative to budget. 


Quality of hires based on performance and retention metrics. 


Candidate satisfaction scores from surveys or feedback. 


Recruitment process adherence to policies and timelines. 


Timely and efficient processing of work permits and visas.




 


Working Conditions 




Full-time role based at IBSUniversity, with occasional travel for recruitment fairs and events. 


Ability to work extended hours during peak recruitment periods.

Hastings Deering (PNG) Limited is one of the largest Caterpillar dealer networks in the world. Job Type:
 
Permanent
 
 


About us 


K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate. 


We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.

This position is responsible for the service and maintenance of Exploration Drill/Diamond Drills such as Atlas Copco and Boart Longyear Exploration Drills and other similar Exploration Equipment. You will carry out tasks as directed by the Mobile Maintenance Superintendent for the general operation of the mine maintenance, while maintaining safe working practices for subordinates plus staff working environment.


Key Accountabilities




Ensure efficient, safe and continuous operation of the underground mine and surface mobile fleet in achieving production targets.


Repair and maintenance of all company under ground and surface heavy diesel equipment and machinery.


Give direction, coaching and technical assistance to subordinates.


Maintain stock levels and place orders as required.


Conduct general housekeeping at work area.


Identify and report safety hazards.

Perform all roles and responsibilities that support and reflect the company’s mission and core values. 


Give direction, coaching and technical assistance to Trade Assistant’s and apprentice.




 


About You 


Qualifications & Experience


To be considered for this role, it is essential that you must have a NATTB certified Trade Certificate in Heavy Equipment Fitting with 3+ years’ experience in mining environment or heavy construction industry. In addition to this, you will have




3 years’ experience in relative technical area


Relevant Experience with Surface Exploration Drills


Valid current driver’s license


Experience with Surface Exploration Drill will be highly advantageous


Possess certified Miner training certificate in area of handling hand drill machine


Ability to perform duties with minimum supervision.


Able to communicate effectively at all levels


Well-versed experience in mining safety management.


Excellent oral and written communication skills.


Proficient in computer and e-mail correspondences.


Ability to meet communicated schedules and deadlines.


Strong planning, interpersonal and organizational skills




Life at K92  


K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.

Prepare and distribute weekly pallet outstanding summaries to all branches every Monday.

Credit Control and Collections

28218.description:
POSITION TITLE:  PRINCIPAL – BALIMO COLLEGE – SCHOOL OF TEACHING


AREA: Education


LOCATION: Balimo College, New Town, Balimo, Delta Fly District, Western Province PNG


TYPE / DURATION: Full time, 1-year Contract


REMUNERATION: Competitive Remuneration Package


REPORTING TO: Executive Principal, Balimo College


 


ABOUT BALIMO COLLEGE:


Balimo College’s vision is to advance Western Province by providing high-quality teaching, research and community engagement. The institute will foster pathways of teachers and health workers who are committed to improving access to vital services in Western Province. Balimo College will be a safe and supportive place for graduates and other professionals across the Western Province catchment region to return for life-long learning and ongoing professional development. The College will develop a community of education and health professionals committed to innovation, excellence and community advancement; by being the training College of choice for Papua New Guineans


Balimo College is funded by SDP and managed by KTF. SDP has a mandate to deliver development programs which provide lasting benefits to the people of Western Province. Our efforts are focused on Health, Education, Infrastructure and Agribusiness. We aim to supplement and complement the efforts of the Fly River Provincial Government (FRPG), in other words, help fill the gaps in the existing systems.


 


Balimo College is recognized as a Higher Education Institute by the National Higher Technical Education Board of the Department of Higher Education, Research, Science and Technology (DHERST). This recognition has been granted in accordance with the provisions of the Higher Education (General Provisions) Act 2014, as amended in 2020, under Section 14(1)(i) and 55(4)(a).


 


 


ABOUT THE ROLE:


The Principal – School of Teaching is responsible for leading the Balimo College – School of teaching by upholding the College’s Vision, Mission, Core Values, Educational Philosophy and Goals. The Principal will operate within the Balimo College executive leadership structure as determined by the Governing Council, to provide strong, effective educational leadership within the parameters identified in this position description.


The Principal will have an in-depth knowledge of the ethos and purpose of the Balimo College and the principles by which it operates. The Principal will have a firm understanding of the Western Province education context and the objectives of Balimo College to create pathways for rural communities into teaching and community health work.


The Principal is responsible for:




Establishing and upholding a management vision for the Balimo College.


Exercising discernment and care in leading staff, students and parents.


Developing and leading a school executive team that will cultivate and strengthen a positive teaching, learning and working environment for all staff and students at every level of operations.


Making operational decisions which support the Balimo College vision and ensure the smooth day to day operations of the College.




 


RESPONSIBILITIES:


 


Vision, Mission and Culture




Uphold the Mission, Vision, Values, Educational Philosophy and Goals of the Balimo College in all operations.






Be able to think strategically, hold a vision for the College and lead others to the realisation of that vision.


Establish a College culture that will characterise the College as a place of care, academic excellence, transparency and integrity, accountability, and commitment to community.


Establish a strong collaborative service culture within the College and local community.




Human Resources




Take responsibility for, and be directly involved in, the appointment of teachers and support staff in accordance with the Balimo College Employment policies and practices, and work collaboratively with the Governing Council in the appointment of fulltime staff.


Recommend the hiring, rewarding, disciplining, terminating, and remuneration of College employees except for him/herself, in direct consultation with the Governing Council and in accordance with policy and/or approved budgets.


Induct, supervise and evaluate performance of all staff in accordance with College policies and practices: provide counselling and assistance as indicated; recommend appropriate action in cases of substandard performances; identify and encourage individual teachers and support staff with leadership potential.


Ensure written communication of employment details to teaching and non-teaching staff occurs annually, or more often as required, in consultation with the Executive Principal.




Administration




Be familiar with College administration procedures and seek to streamline processes and effect efficient practices in liaison with the administration staff.


Liaise with the Governing Council and Executive Principal in setting budgets for the school.


Monitor actual spending against budget, in consultation with the Executive Principal, taking steps to ensure that budgets are not exceeded.


Take responsibility for ensuring that the College fulfils all requirements associated with registration with the PNG Department of Higher Education, Research, Science & Technology (DHERST), National Department of Education (NDOE) and Teaching Services Commission (TSC) in consultation with the Governing Council.


Attend all Governing Council meetings.


Prepare the School calendar in collaboration with the Leadership Team.


Ensure appropriate tasks are delegated to staff to ensure all operations are effective and efficient.


Plan and facilitate staff meetings and strategic professional learning and development.


Regularly review the documentation and implementation of College rules and behavioural expectations.


Prepare teaching allocations and responsibilities.


Preparation of the timetable.


Oversee preparation of the new Staff Induction Program.


Oversee the annual staff induction into all relevant policy documents.


Have a working knowledge of the College administration systems and College policies.


Ensure that the maintenance requirements are documented and that regular maintenance occurs around the College as per the Maintenance Policy.


Make recommendation to the Governing Council for improvement of facilities.


Ensure that Occupational Health and Safety Policy and Procedures are adhered to.


Maintain up to date files electronically and/or in print of all administrative systems, such as: student records, staff records and archives.


Take an active role in the ongoing review, development and implementation of College policies and the annual College Business Plan.


Recommend new policy and initiatives to the Governing Council.




Teaching & Learning




Actively and pro-actively enhance the quality of teaching and learning.


Analyse and evaluate available data on student performance and take appropriate action to improve teaching and learning outcomes.


Oversee curriculum development, curriculum review and balance of curriculum in line with the College educational directions and the Curriculum Review Policy.


Keep abreast of developments in Digital Learning Technologies and actively promote use by teachers in the classroom.


Oversee assessment and reporting.


Manage a personal teaching load.




Enrolment of Students




Initiate the interview process of prospective students and their families (where appropriate) for enrolment suitability according to the Balimo College Enrolment Policy.


Offer placements to students according to the Balimo College Enrolment Policy.


Liaise with parents/families regarding enrolment of students with special needs and ongoing well being of the students.




Professional Development




Regularly attend Professional Development Training Seminars to keep abreast of current educational trends.


Ensure that all staff actively engage in appropriate Professional Development and facilitate staff attendance at professional development activities.


Keep up to date with current educational thought and practice.


Implement the Balimo College Professional Learning and Development Policy.




Financial Management




Work with the Finance Committee of the Balimo College Governing Council to closely monitor the College’s financial position.


Provide guidance on appropriate future strategies.


Review financial policies.


Provide input to the budget of the College.


Work with the Finance Manager and Finance Committee to manage the budget


Act as a responsible signatory




 


YOUR SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES:


The ideal candidate will have:


 


Knowledge of:




State-of-the-art theories, techniques, and methodologies of personnel and management.


Oral and written communication skills.


Principles and practices of administration and supervision.




Ability to:




Provide leadership and direction to Staff.






Analyse problems, make decisions, and be responsible for those decisions.


Communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with staff and community.


Prepare comprehensive narrative and statistical or financial reports.


Interpret, apply, and explain rules, regulations, policies, procedures and statistics.


Establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with others.


Operate a computer to a high level of competence and other office equipment.


Analyse situations accurately and adopt an effective course of actions.


Meeting schedules and time-lines.


Work independently with little direction.


Plan and organise work.




Formal Qualifications:




Masters level Education qualifications




 


Personal Skills & Attributes:




Strong teacher background.






Care for young people.


Intellectual capacity.


Proven ability to lead.


Relational style which commands loyalty.


Ability to lead and work with teams.


Problem solving ability.


Multi-tasking capability.


Strong interest in current educational trends.


High administrative ability.


Strong sense of justice.


Ability to confront difficult situations.


Resilience and energy.




Applicants must have the right to work in PNG.


This position will require travel within PNG from time to time; and possible travel to Australia.


 


Balimo College is a child safe organisation committed to the protection of people we serve. Our recruitment and selection procedures are designed to ensure we only recruit people who are suitable and aligned with our policies that ensure the safety of children and protection of all from sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment. All appointments are subject to appropriate background checks and screening and the successful candidate will be required to get a Working With Children check and/or a Police Certificate. We promote diversity and equality in all our practices and strongly encourage those with diverse backgrounds and/or disabilities and or those who identify as LGBTQI+ to apply for positions with Balimo College.


 


Balimo College strongly encourages all staff get vaccinated against COVID-19. This is not only for the protection of you, but also for the protection of our staff and the communities in which we work in.


 


HOW TO APPLY 


Apply by emailing 
[email protected]
 with the following details:




A cover letter addressing your vision for Balimo College – School of Teahing and how your leadership experience will support academic quality, staff performance, and student outcomes.


Your Resume


Your Qualifications


A Police Clearance Certificate




 








Apply

Balimo College’s vision is to advance Western Province by providing high-quality teaching, research and community engagement. The institute will foster pathways of teachers and health workers who are committed to improving access to vital services in Western Province. Balimo College will be a safe and supportive place for graduates and other professionals across the Western Province catchment region to return for life-long learning and ongoing professional development. This recognition has been granted in accordance with the provisions of the Higher Education (General Provisions) Act 2014, as amended in 2020, under Section 14(1)(i) and 55(4)(a).


 


ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Head of Strand will have an in-depth knowledge of the ethos and purpose of the Balimo College and the principles by which it operates. Attend all Professional Development meetings, attend termly staff meetings and record details if required by the principal for wider circulation to staff;


Lead on department meetings, scheduling, filing and reporting, bringing the team together regularly;


Report on, record and file the moderations necessary in your department;


Be familiar with the Balimo College calendar an attend all calendared meetings and lectures in a timely manner;

Monitor and record student’s information clearly, coherently and confidentially for the identification and conducting of learner assessments;






Alert the Principal to any maintenance requirements that you are aware of;


Keep the Principal informed of the requirements within the College for teaching loads and capacity, resources, and timetabling;


Report annually on the Colleges success, and areas of weakness, data collated and with activity plan for the next year;






Undertake planning and reporting per semester for the administration and academic programs;


Organise and run the Performance Management of staff with feedback to the Principal on any issues or recommendations arising;


Alert the Principal to any issues of Occupational Health and Safety Policy and Procedures on site.




Teaching & Learning




Actively and proactively enhance the quality of teaching and learning, for your own teaching and across the College.


Analyse and evaluate available data on student performance, your own and staff and take appropriate action to improve teaching and learning outcomes.


Promote the use of ICT and of developments in Digital Learning Technologies and actively support the students to enable their studies with the support of ICT;


Engage in developing ICT opportunities with technologies and support utilising technology for implementation in the classroom;


Support the Principal with the delivery and moderation of assessment and reporting across whole staff cohort;


Undertake plan and facilitate moderation sessions for your department teams;


Support staff with ideas, motivation, and feedback to develop pedagogical thinking and understanding.


Manage a personal teaching load within specialism.




Enrolment of Students




Support the Principal with the interview process of prospective students and their families (where appropriate) for enrolment suitability according to the Balimo College Enrolment Policy;


Support the Principal (where appropriate) with the decision-making around the chosen candidates for offer of placements at Balimo College according to the Balimo College Enrolment Policy;


Liaise with parents/families regarding enrolment of students with special needs and ongoing wellbeing of the students.




Professional Development

Attend and be actively engaged in appropriate Professional Development and facilitate staff attendance at professional development activities;


Keep up to date with current educational thought and practice;


Discuss professional pathways with line management during PD sessions;


Engage with Student Feedback Unit reflections with your line management and facilitate the completion of these with the students;


Support staff with the delivery and collection of the SFU process.


Complete Unit Feedback questionnaires in a timely manner;


Support the Principal to implement the Balimo College Professional Learning and Development Policy.

We are hiring!


ACCOUNTING ASSOCIATE


Department: Finance & Accounts
Reports To: Finance Operations Manager / Chief Financial Officer (where necessary)
Location: Lae, Morobe Province, Papua New Guinea


POSITION SUMMARY


 


The Accounting Associate is a full-time position responsible for maintaining accurate and timely financial records of the company and supporting the Finance & Accounts Department in the day-to-day accounting operations.


 


Working within a shipping and logistics environment, the position will handle general ledger activities, accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, invoicing, expense monitoring, financial reporting, and other accounting duties. The officer will work closely with operations, procurement, commercial, and management teams to ensure that financial transactions related to vessels, freight, cargo, port operations, suppliers, customers, and other company activities are properly recorded and supported.


Key Responsibilities:




Perform general accounting and financial controls.


Assist with monitoring accounts payables and accounts receivables.


Assist with Banking and Reconciliations.


Coordinate with relevant departments in reviewing and proper recording of internal and external transactions.


Assist in preparing monthly financial reporting.


Ensure accounting activities comply with company policies, applicable accounting standards, and statutory requirements.




QUALIFICATION and EXPERIENCE


Essential:




Must have the Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.


At least 5 years of relevant accounting experience with strong expertise in General Accounting, Accounts Receivable, and Accounts Payable, preferably within shipping, logistics, transportation, trading, or a similar industry.


Good understanding of general accounting principles and financial controls.


Experience with accounting software/ERP systems.


Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.




Desirable:




Experience in vessel, voyage, freight, port, or logistics accounting.


Knowledge of accounts payable and receivable processes.


Experience with financial reporting and reconciliations.


Membership or progress toward a professional accounting qualification such as CPA, ACCA, CA, or equivalent.




 


SKILLS and COMPETENCIES




Strong attention to detail and accuracy.


Good numerical and analytical skills.


Strong organizational and time-management abilities.


Ability to meet deadlines, particularly during month-end closing.


Good communication and interpersonal skills.


Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


Strong problem-solving skills.


High level of integrity and confidentiality.


Ability to manage multiple accounting tasks and priorities.


Good understanding of Excel and accounting systems.




Note:
 This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by the position. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and requirements.


 


Interested applicants meeting the above qualifications and have the requirements, you may submit your updated CV with photo and credentials thru emailing 
[email protected]

The HR Manager


Bismark Maritime Limited


 


Please clearly mention the position applied in the subject line

28330.description:
About Newmont
At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.
About Lihir
Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.
Your Impact
As
Team Lead, Mine Training
, you will coordinate and deliver end‑to‑end mining training programs that build a safe, skilled, and high‑performing workforce. Leading a team of trainers, you will support competency‑based training for mine operators, maximise the effective use of simulators, and work closely with leaders to assess capability needs and plan impactful training solutions. By maintaining up‑to‑date training materials, ensuring safety and compliance, monitoring effectiveness, and reporting on outcomes, you will play a key role in delivering practical, results‑driven training. Your leadership will ensure our people have the skills, confidence, and capability to perform at their best.
As part of our team, you will
Lead and support a team of trainers, fostering consistency, quality, and compliance across all training activities. Through strong people leadership and hands-on technical involvement, you will ensure competency‑based training is delivered effectively, records are accurately maintained, and safe work practices are upheld at all times.
Implement and execute mining training programs aligned with departmental objectives.
Liaise with the Lead Technical Training and department heads to assess needs and plan training strategies.
Maintain and continuously improve training materials in line with industry standards and technology.
Monitor and evaluate training effectiveness using feedback and performance data, reporting outcomes accordingly.
Supervise, mentor, and guide trainers to ensure consistent delivery of training content.
Deliver and oversee competency‑based training for mine operators, including simulator utilisation.
Ensure full utilisation and ongoing support of training simulators.
Maintain accurate training documentation and compliance records.
Provide hands-on technical support during training sessions as required.
Ensure adherence to safety and operational protocols, with authority to stop unsafe work.
Prerequisites for your success in this role
To succeed in this role, you will bring a strong blend of technical expertise, training capability, and people leadership, underpinned by sound judgement and a practical, solutions‑focused mindset.
Trade or tertiary qualifications in Mining, Training, or a related technical discipline, supported by relevant industry experience.
Demonstrated experience in mining training program development, delivery, and assessment, ideally within operational mining environments.
Proven people leadership capability, with the ability to mentor, guide, and motivate trainers while fostering a positive and productive team culture.
Strong working knowledge of mining operations, including safety, operational, and compliance requirements.
Ability to complete structured procedural tasks while adapting methods where required.
Confidence in following established processes, while identifying opportunities to improve ways of working through experience and observation.
Practical problem‑solving skills, using judgement, trial and error, and collaboration to overcome challenges or seek support when needed.
Advanced proficiency in technical training development, delivery, and team leadership, appropriate to a Team Lead level.
Experience with competency‑based training frameworks, training simulators, and Learning Management Systems (LMS).
Strong understanding of training effectiveness assessment, performance monitoring, and compliance documentation.
High level of computer literacy, with the ability to manage training records, systems, and reporting requirements efficiently.
Your work environment
This role is offered on a 21:21 Fly in, Fly out (FIFO) day shift roster to Lihir Island, Papua New Guinea,
You will work within Newmont’s People and Technical Training function, partnering closely with operational leaders and technical specialists. This role provides the opportunity to work in a dynamic mining environment where safety, collaboration, and continuous improvement are core to how we operate.
Our FIFO employees stay in a secure and comfortable camp, in an en-suited and airconditioned room equipped with mini fridge, TV and Wi-Fi. A variety of healthy meal options are catered for at our mess; and the wet mess provides a relaxed social setting where employees can unwind with a game of pool or darts.
Why Join Newmont
At Newmont, our people are at the heart of our success. We offer:
A strong commitment to safety, inclusion, and sustainable mining practices
Opportunities to lead, influence, and make a lasting impact on workforce capability
Career development and learning opportunities within a global organisation
A values‑driven culture that supports teamwork, respect, and accountability
If you are passionate about developing people, leading teams, and driving training excellence in mining, we encourage you to apply and be part of Newmont’s future.
At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry.
We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond. We know no candidate meets every qualification listed, so if you share our values and feel you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply – we’d love to hear from you!
Submit your application through our website quoting reference number 42415 before the advertised closing date: 14 September 2026.
Apply

The Role
Reporting to the Exploration Manager, the incumbent will play a key role and lead all field teams, tasked with progressing our exploration and resource development targets from generative to resource stage. Woodlark deposit styles range from low to intermediate sulphidation with limited to data rich targets, hosted in volcanogenic terrain with complex lithologies and structural settings. This role will lead the field teams in exploration and is well suited to a field orientated senior Geologist with diverse experience in the exploration sector who wants to join a well-funded project. Possessing a real passion for exploration and a drive to find the next discovery your skills will lead and support the team to advance several exciting projects on Woodlark Island.
Safety is one of our core values at Woodlark Gold, and we expect employees to always act in a manner that seeks to enhance the safety culture and performance of our operation. Environmental stewardship and ethical conduct in exploration activities is expected.
This is a FIFO position working a roster of 4 weeks on, followed by 2 weeks off. Preferred Points of hire include Port Moresby, Lae, Mt. Hagen and Alotau.
About the Role:
Previous experience leading exploration teams and providing proficient geological support and ensuring surface exploration, trenching and drilling programs are completed efficiently and effectively.
Proven track record of successful exploration projects, including the discovery and delineation of mineral resources.
Strong technical proficiency in geological mapping, geochemistry, geophysics, and exposure to mining processes with sound interpretative skills.
Experience managing earthworks, trenching, RC and diamond drilling programs, from planning and execution to data analysis and reporting.
Working with geological and geochemical datasets to assist in interpretation of trenching and drilling results.
Providing timely, accurate and relevant drill reporting (daily, weekly, and monthly), and other internal and external parties as appropriate.
Acting for Exploration Manager and other duties as directed.
About you:
Bachelor of Science Degree in Geology.
Previous exploration experience in essential in epithermal gold and Porphyry Cu systems (desirable).
Minimum of 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in mineral exploration.
Strong leadership capacity in all aspects of exploration, from surface mapping and sampling, trenching, RC, and diamond drilling activities, QAQC implementation and control and rehabilitation.
Experience using Microsoft Office Suite and proficiency in relevant GIS (MapInfo/Discover, QGIS), digital data capture software (desirable) and 3D software. Ability to plan and manage drilling in 3D software (Micromine preferred).
Production of reports plans and sections (Micromine preferred), and assisting is presentations.
Good written and verbal communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
Strong communicator, analytical, critical thinking skill and willingness to make a positive improvement.
Be self-driven and motivated, willing to mentor geologists and field technicians, contribute your ideas in a positive and proactive manner, share your skills and inspiring the team.

Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited operates the Kainantu Gold Mine in the Eastern Highlands Province. Since we launched in 2016, we've grown gold production every year, boosting Papua New Guinea's economy. We take pride in supporting your communities, with nearly 94% of our team members being fellow PNG locals.
Looking ahead, we will significantly increase our gold production in the next three years. This expansion means that K92 is a place for building a stable career, contributing to the community, and being a key part of our success.
About the role
Maintain mining equipment tyres and rim assemblies.
Knowledge of machines and tools, including their designs, uses, repair, and maintenance.
Capable of working safe and promote a safe working environment.
Key / Major Accountabilities
Assessment of tyre wear patterns.
Distinguish tyres wearing unevenly and recommend solutions.
Must have knowledge of tire pressure levels and methods to repair and patch damaged tires.
Recommend certain types of tyres based on vehicles and driving patterns also considering the geographical locations and weather conditions.
Locate punctures in tubeless tyres by visual inspection or by immersing inflated tyres in water baths and observing air bubbles.
Remove, fit and inspect wheel alignments.
Conduct NDT rim inspection
Able to remove and install earthmoving tyres with mechanical aids.
Repair tyre machines or systems using the needed tools.
Follow safety procedures and guidelines in place and strict observance of housekeeping.
Identify and report safety hazards.
Maintain safety work standards in accordance with government regulations and company policy.
Perform all roles and responsibilities that support and reflect the company’s mission and core values.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you should have;
Grade 10 certificate
3 years’ experience in Heavy Equipment Tyre repairs or Automotive Mechanic.
Sound communication skills
Self-starter, and very resourceful, with the ability to find solutions to problems to ensure the equipment availability is high.
Flexible and adaptable and be a team player.
Able to work long hours.
Must have valid driving license (Class 3 or above)
Must be able to operate tyre handling machines
Life at K92
Our core values — Collaboration, Accountability, Respect, Excellence, and Safety — are central to our operations and fundamental to our success. K92 upholds a commitment to equal opportunity, striving to ensure that every individual can reach their highest potential without experiencing discrimination.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
We believe in sharing our success with our employees. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer participation in long- and short-term incentive plans. We also offer savings programs, medical assistance, as well as access to our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
If you share our values and are looking for your next career step, come join us on this exciting journey. Submit your application through our website today.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP

28304.description:
Newmont produces metals the world needs - safely, responsibly and with care for people, communities and the environment. With a 100+ year history, we continue to shape the future of mining through innovation and strong operational performance. By joining our inclusive, world-class team, you can help shape the future of mining and make a meaningful difference.
Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.
Your Impact
At Newmont, reliability is more than equipment performance. It is about ensuring our operations run safely, efficiently, and sustainably every day.
As Supervisor Reliability, you will play a critical leadership role in optimizing plant performance through proactive maintenance, process reliability initiatives, and continuous improvement. Your expertise will help maximize equipment availability, reduce operational risk, and support the delivery of safe and productive outcomes across our processing operations. Through your leadership, coaching, and technical capability, you will contribute directly to operational excellence and the ongoing success of our site.
As part of our team, you will
Lead and coordinate the Asset Management – Reliability activities to ensure optimal equipment performance and operational efficiency.
Monitor plant and process equipment reliability, identifying trends and opportunities for improvement.
Drive compliance with safety standards, risk management processes, and operational procedures.
Coordinate routine maintenance, inspections, and equipment calibration activities.
Analyze reliability performance data and provide recommendations that improve uptime and productivity.
Develop medium and long-term engineering plans to identify and remove equipment reliability risk.
Support troubleshooting and resolution of process and equipment issues in collaboration with maintenance and operational teams.
Build strong working relationships with engineers, technicians, advisors, specialists, contractors, and service providers.
Lead and develop team members by creating a positive, accountable, and high-performing work environment.
Allocate work, provide coaching and feedback, and recognize strong performance.
Champion a culture where people speak up, contribute ideas, and stop unsafe work
Prerequisites for your success in this role
To be successful, you will bring:
A Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience leading a team of professionals in a technical challenging environment
Proven track record in developing and implementing reliability improvement programs that navigate business risk and improve performance.
Demonstrated experience in process safety management, mechanical systems monitoring, and preventative maintenance.

, you will be responsible for assessing, monitoring, and managing the credit risk exposure of the organization. This role ensures that all credit activities comply with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and risk management frameworks.

28300.description:
Newmont produces metals the world needs - safely, responsibly and with care for people, communities and the environment. With a 100+ year history, we continue to shape the future of mining through innovation and strong operational performance. By joining our inclusive, world-class team, you can help shape the future of mining and make a meaningful difference.
Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.
Your Impact
As an Officer, Product Security, you will help safeguard Newmont's operations through proactive security monitoring, incident response, access control, and investigative support. Your work will directly contribute to protecting our people, assets, product, and reputation while supporting a secure and productive mining environment. You will play an important role in identifying risks, responding to incidents, and ensuring security protocols are consistently maintained across site operations.
As part of our team, you will
Monitor site activities and conduct security surveillance to identify and respond to potential risks or unauthorized activity.
Respond to security incidents, alarms, and emergencies, taking appropriate action to minimize risk and maintain safety.
Support investigations into security breaches and incidents, gathering information and documenting findings.
Implement and enforce site security procedures, access control protocols, and compliance requirements.
Assist in maintaining the integrity of site entry points, physical security systems, and monitoring technology.
Work collaboratively with operational teams, camp-based personnel, community stakeholders, and local authorities to maintain a secure operating environment.
Utilise security technologies including CCTV and control room systems while producing clear and accurate reports.
Contribute to a culture of teamwork, professionalism, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
Prerequisites for your success in this role
To be successful in this role, you will bring:
Security Industry Authority Certification (or equivalent recognised security qualification).
Current driver's license.
Minimum 3 years' experience in a security-related role.
Familiarity with CCTV systems, control room operations, and security monitoring environments.
Strong computer literacy with the ability to prepare incident reports and maintain accurate records.
Sound understanding of security protocols, risk assessment, and incident response practices.
The ability to remain calm under pressure and make practical decisions during security-related incidents.
Strong interpersonal skills with a demonstrated ability to build positive working relationships across diverse teams.
Investigation experience and exposure to mining, industrial, or resource sector environments will be highly regarded.
Knowledge of gold processing or mining operations will be advantageous.
Your work environment
This role is offered on a 21:21  Fly-in, Fly-out (FIFO) roster to Lihir Island, Papua New Guinea.
Our FIFO employees stay in a secure and comfortable camp environment, with ensuite, air-conditioned accommodation equipped with a mini fridge, television and Wi-Fi. A variety of nutritious meal options are available through the on-site catering facilities, while recreational and social amenities provide opportunities to relax and connect with colleagues while on roster.
You'll join a professional and supportive security team where development, training, and career progression are encouraged. This role offers opportunities to broaden your experience across security operations, investigations, technology, and risk management while working in a dynamic mining environment.

Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.

Complete all work that is required in the surface mining environment – you will carry out all civil, carpentry, and plumbing works required within the 800L mining office areas. This includes, but is not limited to, building construction and repairs, installation of fixtures, plumbing connections, water line maintenance, and general facility upkeep to support ongoing mining operations.

Carpentry works framing, flooring, door/window installation, roofing repairs.
Construction and maintenance of office structures, walkways, platforms, and storage areas.
Plumbing works: installation and repair of water lines, fittings, drainage, pipe runs.

Material handling up to 25kg and safe use of power and hand tools.
Ensure all work complies with safety standards and mine procedures.
Safely use hand tools, Airleg and rock drills to undertake certain tasks.
Physical activity involving upper arm, shoulder and torso work.
Follow all the safety rules and relevant operating procedures.

Cleaning of equipment and vehicle after use.

Vocational training certificate (Carpentry/Plumbing).
Has minimum of 3+year experience in similar working environment.
Ability to read and write both Pidgin and English
Ability to relate to mine workers comprising different ethnic groups.
Demonstrated teamwork, adaptability, and responsibility
Be always very safety conscious and be able to identify risks.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.

In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.

28290.description:
Job Title: Sales Team Leader
Join MTIS PNG Limited and make a positive impact in the industry while advancing your career!
MATERIAL TESTING INDUSTRIAL SUPPLIES (MTIS) PNG LIMITED
Company Overview
At MTIS Group, we keep some of the region’s most critical industries moving. Since 2006, we have delivered industrial projects, life-cycle services, and product fulfilment solutions to the mining, construction, petrochemical, and infrastructure sectors. Operating from our Motukea headquarters and backed by established operations in Australia since 2015, we support major projects across Papua New Guinea and the Pacific.
We're a hands-on, solutions-focused business that values teamwork, innovation, and getting the job done right. While we take our work seriously, we also believe work should be rewarding, challenging, and enjoyable. We are committed to creating opportunities for our people to learn new skills, build successful careers, and be part of a supportive team environment.
Role Overview
We are growing and as a result we are looking for an accomplished Sales Team Leader to join our team to drive growth across the mining, industrial and oil & gas sectors in Papua New Guinea.
This is a senior role responsible for leading the sales team, developing key client relationships and delivering commercial growth.
We are particularly seeking someone who is highly methodical, organised and detail-focused, with strong systems discipline, data accuracy and sales analytics capability. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with sales systems and reporting, analysing performance and ensuring information is accurate and up to date.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue targets.
Lead, mentor and develop the sales and marketing team.
Build and maintain key client relationships.
Identify new business opportunities and grow the sales pipeline.
Oversee quotations, proposals and contract negotiations.
Ensure accurate and timely processing of all sales transactions and customer information within company systems.
Monitor and analyse sales data, pipeline activity and team performance.
Provide accurate sales reporting and commercial insights to senior management.
Work closely with internal teams to ensure effective service delivery.
What We're Looking For
Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering or related field.
4–7+ years' sales experience, including 3+ years in a leadership role.
Proven sales success, ideally within mining, industrial or oil & gas.
Strong knowledge of the PNG industrial market highly desirable.
Exceptional attention to detail with a structured and methodical approach.
Strong analytical skills and confidence working with sales data and reporting.
High level of accuracy when managing CRM and other business system transactions.
Strong leadership, negotiation and communication skills.
Strong commercial and strategic thinking.
Proficiency in CRM systems and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Key Success Metrics
Revenue and sales target achievement.
New client acquisition and pipeline growth.
Customer retention and profitability.
Accuracy of system transactions and sales data.
Quality of sales reporting and analytics.
Team performance.
What We Offer
A key leadership role in a growing business.
Exposure to major mining and energy clients in PNG.
The opportunity to shape sales strategy and make a genuine commercial impact.

Provided to and from work via designated pick-up point.
