28281.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
This position is responsible for the service and maintenance of fixed plant equipment in a safe and appropriate manner. You will ensure a preventative maintenance schedule is adhered to as well as perform reactive maintenance when equipment breaks down to ensure downtime of machinery is minimized.
Key Accountabilities
Maintain and repair fixed plant equipment onsite in a safe, responsible and timely and effective manner ensuring all Fixed Plant and K92 mining standards are met.
Oversee installation, operation, repairs, and maintenance of the Fixed Plant equipment and infrastructures.
Maintain all plant equipment and ensure all planning and scheduling maintenance activities are performed safely and more effectively.
Assist the Maintenance Foreman in performing preventative maintenance programs, perform routine maintenance and enforces statutory requirements and assist to create a zero-base safety culture.
Ensure safe work standards and practices in accordance with mine safety regulations for all tasks performed.
The successful completion of daily work to meet quality standards and deadlines.
Reporting faults and hazards and respond to routine emergency calls for repair and service within the mine site area.
Monitoring and assessment of plant and equipment.
Exercise due care and attention to work in a safe and efficient manner.
Assist in supervising and on-job training for Apprentices and Trade Assistance.
Willingness to assist other trades as and when required.
About You
To be considered for this role, you will have certificates from a recognized Tertiary institution or technical training program in a maintenance trade or completion of a recognized apprenticeship program, or combination of the two.
Trade Certificate Fitting & Machinery / Mechanical Fitting.
Sound knowledge of all Processing Plant Equipment or similar.
Possess the ability to troubleshoot and perform root cause analysis (particularly in diagnosis and fault finding).
Must be a self-starter, and very resourceful, with the ability to find solutions to problems to ensure the equipment availability is maintained and the ability to live in a remote environment with limited facilities.
Flexible, adaptable and be a team player.
Good working knowledge of the principles and practices of OH&S and Fixed Plant.
Be flexible and adaptable to the needs of the business and ability to work harmoniously as part of the team.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.

28280.description:
Supervisor - Metallurgy
About Us
New Porgera Limited (NPL) is a leading mining company dedicated to sustainable practices and community engagement in Papua New Guinea. As the operator of the Porgera Gold Mine, we focus on extracting high-quality mineral resources while prioritizing the well-being of our employees, the environment, and the local communities. Our commitment to safety, innovation, and responsible mining ensures that we not only contribute to the economy but also support the development and prosperity of the regions we operate in. At NPL, we strive to create a positive impact, fostering strong relationships with stakeholders and promoting sustainable growth for future generations.
The New Porgera Limited now has a vacancy for a qualified and experienced individual as
Supervisor - Metallurgy
About the role
Reporting to the Metallurgist, Senior – Metallurgy, the successful candidate will coordinate the routine and non-routine work conducted in the metallurgical plant laboratory and ensure the test work is completed with high standards and in a timely manner.
In this role, you will:
Oversee day-to-day operation of the Met Lab and ensure consumables, lab equipment and safety gears are managed properly
Supervise contractors engaged within the Met group as well as new graduates undertaking training at Met Lab and ensure application of proper work procedures and practices are adhered
Organize and participate in all routine metallurgical tasks, plant surveys, sampling, inventory stock take and test work programs
Ensure timely and accurate execution of laboratory test work and routine metallurgy plant quality checks. Also, relevant reports must be released on time
Provide support to optimize metallurgical performance in the processing plant and assist operational personnel in operation duties as required
Promote environmentally sound work practices among peers and contractors and ensure all environmental requirements are complied with and maintained
Uphold high standards of health and safety awareness, ensuring compliance with NPL’s Occupational Health & Safety Policy and all safety procedures.
About You
To succeed in this role, the ideal candidate will possess the following qualifications and experiences:
Tertiary educational qualifications in Metallurgical or Chemical Engineering
3 or more years of experience in a similar role or plant metallurgist role with supervisory experience
Be Computer Literate with experience in Metallurgical Database and accounting systems.
Possess good communication and organization skills
Physically fit, can work shifts and willing to be on a fly in fly out roster.
Be highly self-motivated and willing to train, share and pass on knowledge to others
Possess good problem-solving skills
Mobilization Requirement
This position is open to PNG Citizens Only
Rotation of 21 days on and 14 days off
Must successfully pass a pre-employment medical including drug and alcohol screening. (This will be arranged only for successful candidates who progress after the interview stage).
Must Have an up-to-date Police Clearance Certificate (acquired within the last 6 months)
Ability to foresee security inadequacies and implement plans to correct them.
Join Our Team as a Supervisor – Metallurgy
At New Porgera Limited, we offer an exciting opportunity to start or grow your career as a
supervisor – Metallurgy
in the Processing department. This role offers valuable experience within a structured and supportive environment. We provide competitive compensation, balanced work schedules, and opportunities for professional growth.
Join us and make a meaningful impact on your career and the community. Apply now and become part of our dynamic team at New Porgera Limited!
Note: This advert will be open until 08
th
September 2026. If you do not hear from NPL within next three (7) days following the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful for this opportunity.
Apply

28279.description:
10 roles. 3 provinces. 1 mission: climate-resilient farming for PNG.
From provincial coordination to national leadership — pick your role.
Real impact, real careers — help PNG farmers adapt and thrive.
About the Organisation and the Project
The South Pacific Community (SPC) — the region's principal intergovernmental organisation, working across the Pacific since 1947 — and the Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI), a treaty-based international body supporting sustainable development, have partnered with Papua New Guinea's Department of Agriculture and Livestock (DAL) to deliver the Agriculture Sector Support Activity (ASSA).
Formally known as the Adaptation of Small-Scale Agriculture for Improved Food Security of Resilient Communities in Papua New Guinea, ASSA is a landmark, multi-year initiative that will work directly with farming communities across Enga, Milne Bay and New Ireland Provinces. Its purpose is to strengthen food security, build climate-resilient agricultural practices and help communities better anticipate, prepare for and respond to climate variability and climate-related shocks — with DAL acting as the Implementing Agency and SPC and GGGI providing funding and technical backing.
About This Recruitment
To build the team that will lead this work, ASSA has partnered with Peopleconnexion to manage end-to-end recruitment for its Project Management Unit (PMU) — a ten-person team responsible for delivering the project on the ground. These roles give you the opportunity to contribute to regional or national impact, and the chance to be part of a program that will shape climate adaptation practice in PNG agriculture for years to come.
If you want a career that puts you at the centre of one of PNG's most significant climate adaptation investments, Peopleconnexion wants to hear from you.
About the Role
This is the leadership role at the heart of ASSA. As National Project Manager, you will provide strategic direction to the entire Project Management Unit, drive delivery of project outputs and outcomes across three provinces, and be the accountable face of the project to the National Project Director, Project Steering Committee, SPC and the Adaptation Fund.
You'll lead a multidisciplinary team of finance, MEL, safeguards, communications, technical and provincial specialists — turning ambitious project design into results communities can see and feel.
Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end implementation of the ASSA Project against approved plans, budgets and donor requirements.
Oversee project governance, risk management and compliance with Adaptation Fund, SPC and PNG Government requirements.
Steward project finances and resources responsibly, ensuring value for money.
Build and maintain high-level partnerships with government, communities, development partners and service providers.
Lead, mentor and build a high-performing, accountable PMU.
Champion evidence-based decision-making, innovation and continuous improvement across the project.
What You'll Bring
A bachelor's degree in project management, agriculture, climate change, development studies, business, economics, public administration or related field.
A demonstrated track record leading large, complex, multi-stakeholder projects or programs to measurable results.
Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and managing significant financial and operational resources.
Strong governance, risk and compliance capability, and the judgement to operate at the highest levels of accountability.
A genuine commitment to climate resilience, food security and community-centred development outcomes.
Why Join the ASSA Team?
Be part of a landmark, multi-year climate adaptation program with real, visible impact for PNG farming communities.
Competitive remuneration aligned to PNG Public Service General Orders (and SPC salary bands for specialist roles).
Work alongside a capable, mission-driven, multidisciplinary team backed by SPC, GGGI and DAL.
A fixed-term contract for the duration of the project (up to five years), subject to performance and funding.
How to Apply
Applications close COB Monday 07th September 2026.
Please submit your CV and a cover letter addressing the selection criteria by clicking on the ‘APPLY NOW’ button
While the strong preference is to build a PNG-led team, for select specialist roles applications are also welcomed from suitably qualified international candidates.
Ten roles. Three provinces. One opportunity to help shape the future of climate-resilient agriculture in Papua New Guinea.
Apply
